text:
maria: Heads-up — aiming to cut v0.15.0 tomorrow EOD UTC. Need quick alignment across api, runtime, console, and SDKs. Please confirm PRs + changelog entries before cutoff. :eyes:

raj: API PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/412 — tests passing locally, waiting on final review from @tobias. I bumped deps and updated openapi tag.

tobias: looking now. Console needs one changelog line added (breaking note about header auth). I'll push a small commit to the console PR in a bit.

emily: runtime canary is green on p2-small for the seq-length change, but we saw a 3% latency bump at 2k tokens in the staging trace. Thoughts on rolling that to prod or doing a targeted config? :thinking_face: 

ada: SDK PR is ready but failing one flaky test in windows runner — it's a timing assert, retrying CI. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/223

maria: checklist for cutoff (short):
- everyone: add a single-line changelog entry under `Unreleased` in your repo
- merge PRs to `release/v0.15.x` branch (not main) unless hotfixing
- tag flow: run `git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "release v0.15.0"` on the release branch and push the tag
- create release notes draft in GH Releases after tag push

Example tag command to run from the repo root:```bash
git fetch origin release/v0.15.x
git checkout release/v0.15.x
git tag -a v0.15.0 -m "release v0.15.0"
git push origin v0.15.0
```

maria: please ping here when you merge. Cutoff window: 16:00-18:00 UTC tomorrow; after 18:00 we freeze branch and only allow security hotfixes with owner + release lead signoff. :shipit:

tobias: will add the console changelog now and queue the merge. tagging note: let's coordinate tag creation to avoid duplicate tags across repos — whoever creates the API tag, call it out here.

raj: I'll create the API tag at 16:05 UTC if all green and I'll post the push output.

emily: re runtime: recommend enabling a small canary rollout (10% traffic) for 24h, then increase. Will open a tiny rollout PR to the runtime autoscale config.

ada: retried SDK CI, all green now, merging in 5.

sre-bot: CI status: api#412 ✓, sdk#223 ✓, console#189 ✗ (changelog missing) — run: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/5678

maria: perfect, thanks team. If you hit blockers, drop quick notes here (or DM). I'll follow up tomorrow AM with a reminder and final cutoff countdown at 15:30 UTC. :rocket:
